guards.operation.CLAIMED.READY: Recovery only; prove no dispatch and old worker isolated; same-operation consumed grant stays consumed.
guards.operation.UNKNOWN.READY: Recovery only; allowed retry_class, authenticated reconciliation evidence with provenance, matching consumed grant, unchanged original authorization and resource preconditions.
guards.operation.CLAIMED.DISPATCHING: Atomic recheck of cancel, epoch, identity, policy, deadline and resource versions before any external dispatch.
guards.task.RUNNING.SUCCEEDED: Outcome verifier confirms requirements and no unresolved operations.
guards.approval.APPROVED.CONSUMED: First claim of this operation only; safe retry reuses matching consumed record without status reversal.
guards.task.*.CANCELLED: No DISPATCHING or UNKNOWN operation remains; otherwise RECONCILING.
guards.task.RECONCILING.QUEUED: Recovery service only after unresolved outcomes are reconciled; ordinary resume and new IDs cannot bypass resource quarantine.
guards.network.request_scope: Effective permissions are the intersection of profile policy, principal grant, workspace policy and request scope. Requests cannot expand authority.
